name: veterinary_clinic_system_014_boarding_occupancy_snapshot
instruction: Record the occupancy snapshot the morning huddle uses. Create veterinary_clinic_system_ops_reports with one row per location: {report: 'boarding_occupancy', batch_code: <episode batch code>, location_id, total_runs, occupied_runs, occupancy_pct: <round(100*occupied/total, 1)>}. Exactly 3 rows.

success_criteria.summary: Recompute per-location totals/occupied from live boarding_runs; assert 3 rows, exact ints, pct within 0.05, batch_code==nonce.

checks.expect: Recompute per-location totals/occupied from live boarding_runs; assert 3 rows, exact ints, pct within 0.05, batch_code==nonce.

domain_searches.query: boarding kennel vaccination requirements dogs rabies DHPP bordetella before check-in policy
top_results: Boarding Requirements and Instructions - Kingdale Kennels

uniqueness_searches.query: boarding occupancy snapshot percentage by location veterinary kennel report
top_results: Occupancy Report – Pet Manager Software - Official Documentation

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Simple aggregation but exact-count + live-nonce fields defeat hardcoding; baseline of the report family.
